[b][font=Times New Roman]DESCRIPTION﻿[/font][/b]

I have no Idea how to make a mod of Toge since he doesn't speak much but I'll try my best to make changes from time to time. This was only for fun and because I love him very much.

﻿Toge Inumaki﻿ is one of the supporting characters in the series of JJK, who bears the the seal markings of cursed speech﻿.

He may not be able to communicate well like others, so I've prepared a dictionary for his Safe words.

[b]Salmon[/b] - Agree
[b]Fish Flakes[/b] - Disagree
[b]Kelp[/b] - Greeting
[b]Mustard Leaf[/b] - Concern/Worry, "I'm on it"﻿﻿
[b]Salmon Roe[/b] - "Well, well" or "My, my"
[b]Caviar[/b] - Curse word
[b]Spicy Cod Roe[/b] - Used motivationally
[b]Tuna[/b] - "look"
[b]Tuna Mayo[/b] - General talk or "Do something" (about the situation)
everything else is gibberish 

[b](note: safe words may vary depending on the expression, and I have added a few words since I can’t think of any more dialogues for him. Mainly adjectives, nouns and a few names. ALSO there are some dialogues that I can't change as it is the default.)
[/b]
More info about [url=http://ujutsu-kaisen.fandom.com/wiki/Toge_Inumaki]Inumaki[/url].
